summary: 14. Chief Executive Officer, Maithon Power Limited, Maithon Power Limited MA-5, Gogna Colony. Post Office: Maithon Dhanbad PIN-828207 The instant Petition has been filed by the Petitioner, National Load Despatch Centre (NLDC) under sub-section (4) of section 28 of Electricity Act 2003 read with Regulation 32 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Fees & Charges of Regional Load Despatch Centre and other related matters) Regulations, 2019 and in compliance to the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission order dated 28.03.2023 for approval of Performance Linked Incentive for NLDC and RLDCs for the Financial Year 2023-24. - c) _Allow the Applicant to recover the PLI amount from the users for the year 2023-24 as approved by the Hon’ble Commission._ - d) _Pass such other order as the Hon’ble Commission deems fit and appropriate in this case and in the interest of justice_ Table-1 referred in the prayer (a) is at Annexure-I and Table-2 referred in the prayer (b) is at Paragraph 3(g) of this order. Regulations, 2019”). The said regulations are applicable to the determination of fees and charges for NLDC and RLDCs for the control period 2019-24. - d) Accordingly, NLDC and RLDCs had filed the Petitions for approval of Performance Linked Incentive for Financial Years 2019-20, 2020-21 and 2021-22. The Commission, while approving the PLI for FYs 2019-20 and 2020-21, vide order dated 28th March 2023, directed NLDC to file a consolidated petition for FYs 2021-22, 2022-23, and 2023-24. - e) As per the methodology defined in the Procedure approved by the Commission vide Order dated 20.05.2022, NLDC and RLDCs have computed the Key Performance Indicators for the financial year ending 31 st March 2024. The KPIs computed by NLDC & RLDCs for FY 2023-24, along with the marks scored, are attached at Annexure-I to this order. 4. The Petition was admitted, and further, the Petitioner was asked to submit the correct weblink of certain KPIs. 5. The Petitioner vide affidavit dated 23.07.2025 has submitted the revised weblinks of the KPIs and additionally submitted the following: - i. KPI A2-1(a) - Power Market Transaction: Bilateral: Processing of scheduling of bilateral transactions within specified time - The details related to the timely processing of scheduling of bilateral transactions are not available in the public domain. Therefore, as per clause 4.2(d) of “Approved detailed procedure for calculation of Key Performance Indicators”, the relevant proof, i.e. sample data of the month of April 2023, has been filed with the affidavit. 6. Based on submissions by Petitioner, the Commission reserved its order in the matter. None of the Respondents has filed any submission. 7. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and have also perused the facts on record. The Petitioner has filed the present petition for the approval of Performance Linked Incentive for NLDC and RLDC(s) for the financial year 2023-24. 9. Regulation 32 of the RLDC Fees and Charges Regulations, 2019 provides as follows: _ (3) NLDC shall submit the details in regards to each Key Performance Indicator in the format specified in Appendix-V along with the methodology for approval of the Commission._ _2.5. The proofs mentioned in the respective KPI details shall also be submitted while filing the petition for approval of the Performance Linked Incentive._ _2.6. An undertaking by the head of concerned RLDC or head of NLDC, as the case may be, shall be submitted along with the Petition stating that the targets claimed to be achieved and performance computed for all KPIs have been checked and are true to best of his/ her knowledge.”_ As per the above, in terms of Regulation 32 of the RLDC Fees and Charges Regulations, 2019 and the approved detailed procedure dated 20.05.2022, the marks obtained against each KPI and the corresponding percentage of the Performance Linked Incentive (PLI) for the Petitioner(s) for the Financial Year 2023-24, are to be recovered from users after approval of the Commission - a) An undertaking by the head of the concerned RLDC and head of NLDC, as the case may be, stating that the targets achieved and performance computed against all KPIs, as mentioned in the Petition, are duly verified and true to the best of their knowledge. 11. The marks submitted by the Petitioner as verified by the Head of NLDC and Heads of RLDCs are found in order. 12.
